For those always on the move, journeys matter as much as destinations. Viva Vivanta! Vibrant spaces where excitement comes alive and creates the per

fect setting for all things new and amazing. Vivanta hotels let you explore the best within and outside, while you connect, create and make unforgettable memories. With a presence in key cities, Vivanta brings you the best 5-star hotels in India and beyond. Here, each experience is a step into the extraordinary.
DESIGNED FOR THOSE
WHO MAKE THINGS
HAPPEN
At Vivanta, energy is always buzzing. Stylish rooms elevate your stay, lively lounges let you kick back with ease and bustling all-day diners let you sample the best – locally and from across the globe. Whether you're catching up on work in sleek corners, rejoicing with friends and family or enjoying an end-of-the-day dip in the pool - contemporary flair marks each moment. With access to premium urban addresses that bring you the best of modern chic, Vivanta invites you to live, thrive and make the most of every experience.
Relax and recharge at our outdoor pool, perfect for unwinding after a workout or simply enjoying a refreshing dip. Surrounded by greenery, our hotels with a pool offer a calm space to relax, whether you're swimming laps or sunbathing.
